# opnsense_interfaces_settings (Resource)

Manages global OPNsense interface settings. This is a singleton resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `dhcp6_debug` (Boolean) Enable DHCPv6 client debug logging.
- `dhcp6_duid` (String) Custom DHCPv6 DUID. Leave unset to use the current/default DUID.
- `dhcp6_no_release` (Boolean) Do not send DHCPv6 release messages.
- `dhcp6_ra_timeout` (Number) Router-advertisement timeout in seconds.
- `disable_checksum_offloading` (Boolean) Disable hardware checksum offloading.
- `disable_ipv6` (Boolean) Disable IPv6 globally.
- `disable_large_receive_offloading` (Boolean) Disable hardware large receive offloading.
- `disable_segmentation_offloading` (Boolean) Disable hardware TCP segmentation offloading.
- `vlan_hardware_filtering` (String) VLAN hardware filtering mode: `0`, `1`, or `2` (default).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Fixed singleton identifier `interfaces_settings`.
